newsitem.title: UK: Aussie merinos tempt tops-buyers to Bradford market.
newsitem.headline: Aussie merinos tempt tops-buyers to Bradford market.

text.p: Uptrending Australian raw wool prices inspired fresh buying in the Bradford wool tops market, industry sources reported on Thursday.
Traders said the pick-up percolated down from finer tops and new demand emerged for medium blends.
One source said the expectation in the market was that strength in merino values could end up spreading to crossbreds.
The possibility of wholesale rises for the raw fibre had brought tops-buyers back to the bargaining table, he said.
UK tops prices were generally firm in the week although mixed results for Australian merinos on Tuesday led to some minor reductions from earlier highs, traders said.
The overall business climate appears brighter as more local firms report increased calls for delivery.
But recent ownership changes in the combing sector have been creating production problems, sources said. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
